fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (NYSE:V) rose 2.4% to $423.53 as Cantor Fitzgerald raised price target from $445 to $500 (implying 12.4% upside), maintaining Overweight rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal Q4 revenue of $12.1B increased 13%, though payment volume growth was only 9%, with revenue outpacing transaction volume by 4 percentage points—a key sustainability indicator.
fields.summary_ko.2: GF Score 97/100 and PER of 35.24 suggest elevated valuation; maintenance of revenue-volume gap in next quarter is critical.
